title: Children’s Festival Family Feedback
description: We value your thoughts and ideas. Your feedback helps us create festivals and activities that bring families together and support children’s growth.

fields.label: 1. What did your family enjoy most about today’s festival?
2. What was meaningful or valuable for you as a parent?
3. How do you think festivals like this benefit children and families?
4. What ideas or activities would you like to see in future festivals?
5. Is there any way you or your family would like to contribute ideas, skills, or support?

fields.text: Thank you for being part of building a welcoming and connected community.
